indicators: Existing git tags force-pushed to new commits instead of new versions being published
composer.json autoload.files gains src/helpers.php, executed on require vendor/autoload.php
Second-stage PHP credential stealer targeting CI and developer machines
Rewritten commits are dated between 2026-05-22T22:32Z and 2026-05-23T00:00Z; a lock whose pinned commit carries such a date installed one of them
summary: Existing tags of four laravel-lang Composer packages were rewritten with a credential stealer that runs during Composer bootstrap; no new version number and no CVE were issued.
remediation: Pin each laravel-lang package to a commit SHA verified to predate 2026-05-22T22:32Z, reinstall vendor from scratch, and rotate every credential present on machines or CI runners that installed these packages after that time.

sources.title: Laravel-Lang Supply Chain Attack: Every Tag Across Multiple Composer Packages Rewritten to Steal CI Secrets
Supply Chain Attack Targets Laravel-Lang Packages with Credential Stealer

review.notes: Approved by the PO on 2026-10-27 after checking both sources. Today the tags point to normal October commits, composer.json has no autoload.files, the org published no advisory and OSV is still empty. Sprint 2b: window end set to 2026-05-23T00:00Z (end of the rewrite phase per StepSecurity); matching = lock commit differs from the registry commit for the same version, or a commit dated inside the window.
